findings.title: Session token compared with a non-constant-time equality
findings.label: bug
findings.claim: The session token is compared with ===, leaking the position of the first differing byte through timing.
findings.detail: Three skeptics judged this candidate. Two could not refute it and one refuted it, and none errored — valid 3, quorum 2, refutes 1. Since refutes * 2 (2) is below valid (3), huginn-quorum-v1 resolves the finding as verified: a lone refuter does not carry a three-skeptic panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Compare with crypto.timingSafeEqual over equal-length Buffers derived from the presented and stored tokens.

findings.title: Spec's session-revocation requirement has no implementation
findings.label: spec-gap
findings.claim: The spec requires that revoking a session invalidates outstanding tokens; nothing in the session module revokes anything.
findings.detail: Two of the three skeptics errored mid-refute and returned 'unverified-flagged', so their votes are dead and tally into abstained. That leaves valid 1 below the quorum of 2, so huginn-quorum-v1 resolves the finding as abstained: it is KEPT with verified:false and flagged, never dropped. Too few skeptics came back for the panel's verdict to count either way.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement revocation (a server-side revocation list or a token version counter) and assert it in the session tests.

summary: Multi-skeptic run: three verifier votes per candidate. F1 survived 2-1 (verified). F2 lost two skeptics to mid-refute errors, leaving one valid vote below the quorum of 2, so it is kept and flagged as abstained rather than dropped. A third candidate — 'Login handler logs the raw password on failure' (correctness, src/auth/login.ts:120) — drew one refute against one keep among its two valid votes; a tie satisfies refutes * 2 >= valid, so huginn-quorum-v1 dropped it and it is absent from findings[]. A dead verifier vote is surfaced per finding as verified:false with voteResolution 'abstained', not as a coverage degrade: degraded is false and degradedReasons is absent.
